seoTitle: Follower Growth Rate Calculator with Projection
metaDescription: Compute follower growth in numbers and percent, per day and per month, and project counts at the same pace. Free and private.
intro: Compute follower growth in numbers and percent between two counts, per day and per month, and project future counts at the same pace.
why:
Growth numbers mean little without a period. Fifty followers a week is fast for a small account and slow for a large one.

Enter the start count, the current count and the days between. The tool shows the change, the percentage, the per-day and per-month pace and the compound monthly rate, then projects the count at that pace both linearly and compounded. Growth rarely stays steady, so treat the projection as a planning aid.
howTo: Enter the follower count at the start and now.
Enter the number of days between.
Set how many months to project.
Compare the linear and compound columns.

faq.a: Linear adds the same number each month, compound grows by the same percentage. Compound runs away on long periods.
No. It assumes the recent pace continues.

faq.q: Can I use it for subscribers or email lists?
faq.a: Yes. It works for any count.
